language.description: Locale code used in this file (e.g. 'ptBR', 'enUS').

fields.description: Field definitions keyed by field name.

field.description: Unified field definition for both listview columns and form fields.

accessor.description: Dot-notation path to the value in the record (e.g. 'empresa.nome').

options.description: Reference to an options table for select fields.

colWidth.description: Column width in pixels or percentage.

colStyles.description: Style keyword or list of style keywords for the column cells.

emphasizeColumn.description: Whether to visually emphasize this column with special styling.

footer.description: Column footer text template. Supports macros: {count}, {unique}, {sum}.

footerIcon.description: Icon name to show in the column footer cell instead of text.

header.description: Column header text template. Supports macros: {count}, {unique}, {sum}.

headerIcon.description: Icon name to show in the column header cell next to the title.

render.description: Custom rendering configuration for the column.

wrapperWidth.description: Width of the form field wrapper (badge) for colorWrapper render layout.

label.description: Label text displayed above the input field.

fieldWidth.description: Width of the form field. Can be a number (pixels) or percentage string.

filterWidth.description: Width of the filter field. Can be a number (pixels) or percentage string. If not given, 'fieldWidth' is used.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text shown when the field is empty.

filterPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text for filter inputs. If not given, 'placeholder' is used.

defaultValue.description: Default field value for new records.

required.description: Whether the field is required for form submission.

readOnly.description: Whether the field is read-only (not editable).

enabled.description: Whether the field is enabled. Defaults to true.

optionsRef.description: Reference to an options table for populating select fields.

table.description: Name of the data table containing the options.

valueAccessor.description: Dot-notation path to the value field. Defaults to 'value'.

labelAccessor.description: Dot-notation path to the label field. Defaults to 'label'.

fieldRender.description: Custom rendering configuration for a column.

op.description: Operation for 'link' layout. 'edit' opens the record, 'email' opens mailto.

fieldRenderValue.description: A value entry for stacked column rendering.

accessor.description: Dot-notation path to the value in the record.

styles.description: CSS class names or style keywords (e.g. 'bold', 'italic', 'small').

mask.description: Mask configuration for formatting this stacked value.
Mask configuration for formatting string values.

pattern.description: Mask pattern where '0' represents a digit (e.g. '0000' or '0.00-0').

digits.description: Total number of digits expected in the value.
